events.title: 베이징에서 태어나다
events.description: 베이징에서 태어났다. 본가는 후난성 류양이었고 아버지는 호북 순무까지 오른 지방 대관이었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Beijing, though his family's roots lay in Liuyang, Hunan. His father rose to become governor of Hubei.

events.title: 여러 성을 떠돌며 견문을 넓히다
events.title_en: He traveled widely, broadening his outlook
events.description: 젊어서 여러 성을 떠돌며 각지의 현실을 몸으로 겪었다. 이 경험이 훗날 전통 학문에 얽매이지 않는 사상으로 이어졌다.
events.description_en: In his youth he traveled across many provinces, seeing local realities firsthand. The experience later shaped a way of thinking unbound by traditional scholarship.

events.title: 인학을 쓰다
events.description: 왕부지의 사상과 공양학, 불교, 서구 지식까지 아울러 인학을 완성했다. 삼강의 봉건 질서를 정면으로 비판한 변법파 최초의 철학서였다.
events.description_en: He completed Renxue, weaving together the thought of Wang Fuzhi, New Text Confucianism, Buddhism, and Western learning. It was the reform movement's first philosophical work, and it attacked the feudal order of the three bonds head-on.

events.title: 후난에서 시무학당을 세우는 데 참여하다
events.title_en: He helped found the Academy of Current Affairs in Hunan
events.description: 후난 순무 진보잠의 요청으로 성 행정 개혁에 뛰어들어 시무학당과 무비학당 설립을 도왔다. 이곳에서 양계초와 함께 일했다.
events.description_en: At the invitation of Hunan governor Chen Baozhen, he took part in reforming the provincial administration and helped establish the Academy of Current Affairs and a military school. There he worked alongside Liang Qichao.

events.title: 군기장경으로 발탁되다
events.title_en: He was appointed a secretary of the Grand Council
events.description: 광서제가 그를 군기장경으로 발탁해 변법 조칙을 다듬는 핵심 실무진에 세웠다.
events.description_en: Emperor Guangxu appointed him a secretary of the Grand Council, placing him among the small circle drafting the reform edicts.

events.title: 원세개를 찾아가 군사 지원을 청하다
events.title_en: He visited Yuan Shikai to ask for military support
events.description: 서태후가 광서제를 유폐하려 한다는 소식을 듣고 원세개를 찾아가 군대로 변법을 지켜 달라 청했다. 그러나 원세개는 이를 서태후 쪽에 밀고했다.
events.description_en: Hearing that Empress Dowager Cixi planned to place Emperor Guangxu under house arrest, he went to Yuan Shikai and asked him to defend the reform with his troops. Yuan instead reported the plan to Cixi's faction.

events.title: 피신을 거부하다
events.description: 정변 소식에 동지들이 피신을 권했으나 듣지 않았다. 어느 나라든 변법은 피 흘림 없이 이루어진 적이 없으니, 중국에 그 피가 필요하다면 자신부터 흘리겠다고 말했다고 전한다.
events.description_en: When word of the coup broke, his comrades urged him to flee, but he refused. He is said to have declared that no reform in any country had ever succeeded without bloodshed, and if China needed such blood, he would be the first to shed it.

events.title: 채시구에서 처형되다
events.description: 무술육군자 중 한 사람으로 베이징 채시구 형장에서 참수됐다. 서른셋이었다.
events.description_en: As one of the Six Gentlemen of the reform, he was beheaded at the Caishikou execution ground in Beijing. He was thirty-three.
